BACKGROUND. factory/outcome_contract.py already holds `classify_run(run, scene)`, the pure outcome classifier (core tier: per-turn action_outcome and knowledge_progress, stall runs, confirmed_stuck, unresolved, exit, status). Read it, tests/test_outcome_contract.py and tests/fixtures/outcome_contract/README.md (the full contract) and cases.json (the frozen examples) FIRST. The core tier left three result fields as placeholders marked 'intentionally deferred': `provenance_flags` (always []), `pacing` ({}) and `epilogue` (all false). Fill them in now, exactly as the README section 'Extension tier (separate task)' specifies, and nothing else.

DETAILS the README leaves open (decide as stated):
- Double-quoted segments: take text between straight double quotes `"..."` and between curly quotes; an unbalanced quote ends at the end of the text. A segment is checked on its own.
- Whitespace normalisation: collapse runs of whitespace to one space and strip, on both sides, case-sensitive.
- `bookkeeping_voiced` and `character_knowledge`: at most ONE flag per (turn, kind, matched string); a turn that is not a dict or has no string `text` yields no flag.
- `provenance_flags` is sorted by turn (a flag with turn None sorts last), then kind.
- `epilogue_not_offered` has `turn: None`. `epilogue.offered` and `.taken` are false when `scene.epilogue_candidates` is empty or no turn has `ending_latched` true.
- `pacing.exploration_share` is a float rounded to 4 decimals; `quiet_stretch` is 0 when there is no pressure event; `turns_to_first_pressure` is the `turn` value of the first turn with `pressure_event` true, or None.
- `status` now returns `flagged` when there are no unresolved and no confirmed_stuck turns but at least one provenance flag, as the README says.
- Set `contract_version` to `v1`.
- Never mutate inputs; never raise on malformed input (a non-string `text`, non-list `unlearned_terms`, a term entry that is not a dict, and so on are skipped).

TESTS. In tests/test_outcome_contract.py REMOVE the skip of extension-tier cases: the parametrized test must now run every case in cases.json (27 in all), none skipped. Keep every existing test (update any that pinned `contract_version == 'v1-core'`, empty pacing, or the always-empty provenance_flags and say so in NOTES.txt). Add tests of your own: a flag is not raised when the term appears only in narration outside quotes; curly quotes work; two quoted segments in one turn each checked; an unbalanced opening quote; a turn with no `text`; `quiet_stretch` resets on a pressure_event turn and on an npc_move turn and on knowledge_progress; `exploration_share` for zero turns is 0.0; epilogue taken without ever being offered cannot happen (taken implies offered); two separate runs of the classifier on the same input give equal results.

Do not touch the shard_durations file (no new test file is added).
